text: Python becomes mandatory for every gated dispatch, not only bug work.
The hook suite is not safe to run twice at once on one checkout: a parallel pwsh 7 + 5.1 run gave 2 FAIL that a lone run does not reproduce.
Hook cost per gated dispatch: +170 ms (md feature) / +211 ms (registered feature), not the ~190 ms the plan stated; a bug dispatch still starts Python twice.
CSV writes take no lock (the main session is the only writer); the migrate swap is per file, not atomic.
Worktrees share the main checkout's ledger.
A ledger event refused by validation goes to `rounds.rejected-*.json` and is not counted until merged by hand.
The real 15 s harness hook kill was not tested; the 8 s budget is tested with stubs.
The round-cap hook keeps an md fallback for un-migrated feature files (a framework backlog item replaces it with a fail-closed "not migrated" block once the migrate line has shipped to game repos).
A feature md with no `## Bugs` section gets no `- Bugs:` pointer on migrate.
A formula cell planted by hand in an old CSV row is reported by `csv doctor` only; full-width lookalike characters are not covered.

Every CSV value starting with `-` is refused (no bullet or `--flag` exemption): `migrate --from-md` in a game repo whose md tables use a lone `-` for an empty cell is refused until the cell is reworded (0 such cells in this repo).
No live `/feature` run on the new docs, template and CSV commands yet; the first real feature is that run.
The live cap check (QA C1) covered `Feature:` briefs (registry and md fallback) only; the `Bug:` cap path and the Workflow-launch matcher are covered by the hook suite stubs, not live.
Hook latency against the harness 15 s kill is not measured per hook (hook events carry no duration); the live session ran with no hook killed or timed out.
37 pre-slim history table rows in `framework-backlog.md` are kept in the renamed, git-ignored md file, not migrated to `fwbacklog` (they are reference history, not open items).
The real migrate --from-md ran on 2026-11-20 at 29a5cbd before the merge (main checkout, this branch); the other repos that sync this framework still run their own.
